newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian foreign minister to visit U.S. next week.
newsitem.headline: Russian foreign minister to visit U.S. next week.

text.p: Russia's Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov will visit the United States from March 15 to 17 to help prepare for a summit later in the month between the two countries' presidents, a Russian foreign ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
Primakov will meet U.S. President Bill Clinton and Secretary of State Madeleine Albright during a visit to Washington.

Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin are scheduled to meet in Helsinki on March 20 and 21. The most contentious issue on their agenda is a plan by the NATO alliance to invite new members from eastern Europe, a move Russia strongly opposes.
